parameters.query:
-- Yesterday's report_runs roll-up.
-- POE binding: language stays non-punitive (no 'failed', use 'needs-rework').
SELECT
  rr.id,
  rr.report_name,
  rr.status,
  rr.summary,
  rr.metrics_jsonb,
  rr.created_at,
  COUNT(ci.id) FILTER (WHERE ci.disposition = 'pending') AS items_pending,
  COUNT(ci.id) FILTER (WHERE ci.disposition = 'approved') AS items_approved,
  COUNT(ci.id) FILTER (WHERE ci.disposition = 'deferred-next-cycle') AS items_deferred
FROM public.report_runs rr
LEFT JOIN public.cycle_items ci
  ON ci.cycle_id = rr.cycle_id
 WHERE rr.created_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours')
 GROUP BY rr.id, rr.report_name, rr.status, rr.summary, rr.metrics_jsonb, rr.created_at
 ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC;
